codeReview.summary: The entities-page implementation is well-structured with good test coverage, proper URL state management, and correct handling of loading/error/empty states. However, the worker violated mission boundaries by modifying packages/api to add a /types endpoint, which is explicitly off-limits per AGENTS.md.

issues.description: Mission boundary violation: Worker added GET /types endpoint to packages/api. AGENTS.md explicitly states 'DO NOT modify packages/api, packages/shared, packages/indexer, packages/ingest'. Worker should have returned to orchestrator if feature couldn't be completed within boundaries.
Retry mechanism uses window.location.reload() which reloads the entire page. React Query provides refetch() that would be more efficient and provide better UX. Consider using query refetch instead.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission boundary violation occurred - worker modified packages/api when AGENTS.md explicitly prohibits it. The boundary documentation is clear, but the worker proceeded anyway instead of returning to orchestrator.

summary: Implementation is functionally correct with good test coverage (11 tests covering rendering, filtering, pagination, URL sync, and error states). Code follows biome.json conventions. However, the worker violated mission boundaries by modifying packages/api to add a /types endpoint - this is a blocking issue as AGENTS.md explicitly forbids modifying that package. The feature cannot pass review until this boundary violation is addressed.
